newsitem.title: UK: Booker successful in bid for Nurdin.
newsitem.headline: Booker successful in bid for Nurdin.

text.p: Booker Plc said its recommended bid for food wholesaler Nurdin & Peacock had been accepted by 80.3 percent of shareholders by 1400 GMT on October 3.
It said the offer was unconditional as to acceptances.
In a statement, the food distribution company said the offer had been extended to October 17.
Booker launched the offer, which valued Nurdin at around 264 million stg, on September 4.
It offered 14 new Booker shares and 154.53 stg in cash for every 100 Nurdin shares or a full cash alternative of 201 pence per share.
